017package org.apache.juneau.rest.client.mcp.auth;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
021
022import java.net.*;
023import java.time.*;
024import java.util.*;
025
026/**
027 * Single-use, TTL-bounded store for the per-authorization {@code state} &rarr; {@code (codeVerifier, expectedIssuer)}
028 * association created when an interactive authorization-code + PKCE flow is started and consumed when the loopback
029 * redirect arrives.
030 *
031 * <p>
032 * Relocation of the {@code EphemeralStore} pattern from {@code juneau-rest-server-auth-oidc-rp} (Q3) for headless
033 * (CLI/desktop) use.  The browser-session {@code redirectTarget}/{@code nonce} shape is dropped; this headless variant
034 * stores the PKCE {@code code_verifier} and the discovered {@code expectedIssuer} used for the SEP-2468 {@code iss}
035 * check on the callback.
036 *
037 * <p>
038 * Security properties:
039 * <ul>
040 *    <li><b>Single-use</b> &mdash; {@link #consume(String)} atomically removes the entry, so a replayed callback with the
041 *       same {@code state} fails.
042 *    <li><b>TTL-bounded</b> &mdash; entries older than the configured TTL are treated as a miss and swept.
043 *    <li><b>Size-bounded</b> &mdash; an LRU cap (default 1000) prevents unbounded growth from abandoned attempts.
044 * </ul>
045 *
046 * <p>
047 * Thread-safe.
048 *
049 * @since 10.0.0
050 */
051public class EphemeralStore {
052
053   /** Default maximum number of in-flight authorization attempts retained. */
054   public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES = 1_000;
055
056   /** Default time-to-live for a pending authorization (the user has at most a few minutes at the IdP). */
057   public static final Duration DEFAULT_TTL = Duration.ofMinutes(5);
058
059   /** Hard cap on the configurable TTL. */
060   static final Duration MAX_TTL = Duration.ofMinutes(30);
061
062   /**
063    * A pending-authorization association awaiting the IdP loopback callback.
064    *
065    * @param codeVerifier The PKCE {@code code_verifier} string.
066    * @param expectedIssuer The discovered issuer the callback {@code iss} parameter is validated against (SEP-2468).
067    *    May be {@code null} when no issuer was discovered.
068    * @param createdAt The instant the entry was stored.
069    */
070   public record PendingAuthorization(String codeVerifier, URI expectedIssuer, Instant createdAt) {
071
072      /**
073       * Redacts the PKCE {@code codeVerifier} so it never reaches logs via this record's {@code toString()}
074       * (mirrors the {@code OAuthToken} / {@code McpTokenProvider} redaction discipline).
075       *
076       * @return A redacted string form disclosing only non-secret metadata.
077       */
078      @Override
079      public String toString() {
080         return "PendingAuthorization[codeVerifier=<redacted>, expectedIssuer=" + expectedIssuer
081            + ", createdAt=" + createdAt + "]";
082      }
083   }
084
085   private final int maxEntries;
086   private final Duration ttl;
087   private final Clock clock;
088   private final Map<String,PendingAuthorization> entries;
089   private final Object lock = new Object();
090
091   /**
092    * Creates a store with the default TTL, size cap, and system UTC clock.
093    *
094    * @return A new store.
095    */
096   public static EphemeralStore create() {
097      return new EphemeralStore(DEFAULT_TTL, DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES, Clock.systemUTC());
098   }
099
100   /**
101    * Constructor.
102    *
103    * @param ttl The single-use TTL.  Must be positive and not exceed 30 minutes.
104    * @param maxEntries The LRU size cap.  Must be positive.
105    * @param clock The clock for TTL comparisons.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
106    */
107   public EphemeralStore(Duration ttl, int maxEntries, Clock clock) {
108      assertArgNotNull("ttl", ttl);
109      assertArg(!ttl.isZero() && !ttl.isNegative(), "ttl must be positive");
110      assertArg(ttl.compareTo(MAX_TTL) <= 0, "ttl must not exceed 30 minutes (was %s)", ttl);
111      assertArg(maxEntries > 0, "maxEntries must be positive (was %s)", maxEntries);
112      this.ttl = ttl;
113      this.maxEntries = maxEntries;
114      this.clock = assertArgNotNull("clock", clock);
115      this.entries = new LinkedHashMap<>(16, 0.75f, true) {
116         private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
117         @Override
118         protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<String,PendingAuthorization> eldest) {
119            return size() > EphemeralStore.this.maxEntries;
120         }
121      };
122   }
123
124   /**
125    * Stores a pending-authorization association keyed by {@code state}.
126    *
127    * @param state The opaque {@code state} value.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
128    * @param codeVerifier The PKCE {@code code_verifier}.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
129    * @param expectedIssuer The discovered issuer for the SEP-2468 {@code iss} check.  May be <jk>null</jk>.
130    */
131   public void store(String state, String codeVerifier, URI expectedIssuer) {
132      assertArgNotNullOrBlank("state", state);
133      assertArgNotNullOrBlank("codeVerifier", codeVerifier);
134      var now = clock.instant();
135      synchronized (lock) {
136         sweepExpired(now);
137         entries.put(state, new PendingAuthorization(codeVerifier, expectedIssuer, now));
138      }
139   }
140
141   /**
142    * Atomically removes and returns the pending-authorization association for {@code state}, if present and
143    * not expired.
144    *
145    * @param state The {@code state} value from the callback.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
146    * @return The association, or {@link Optional#empty()} if absent or expired.
147    */
148   public Optional<PendingAuthorization> consume(String state) {
149      if (state == null)
150         return oe();
151      var now = clock.instant();
152      synchronized (lock) {
153         var p = entries.remove(state);
154         if (p == null)
155            return oe();
156         if (isExpired(p, now))
157            return oe();
158         return o(p);
159      }
160   }
161
162   /**
163    * Returns the current entry count.  Primarily for tests and metrics.
164    *
165    * @return The entry count.
166    */
167   public int size() {
168      synchronized (lock) {
169         return entries.size();
170      }
171   }
172
173   private boolean isExpired(PendingAuthorization p, Instant now) {
174      return !now.isBefore(p.createdAt().plus(ttl));
175   }
176
177   private void sweepExpired(Instant now) {
178      entries.values().removeIf(p -> isExpired(p, now));
179   }
180}
